newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese net foreign bond buying at 1.2 trln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japanese net foreign bond buying at 1.2 trln yen.

text.p: Net purchases of foreign bonds by Japanese investors totalled 1.2004 trillion yen in August after net purchases of 188.4 billion yen a month earlier, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Wednesday.
Bonds include beneficiary certificates but exclude all bills.
Net selling of Japanese stocks by foreign investors amounted to 94.8 billion yen in August compared with net purchases of 1.3 billion yen the previous month, the ministry also said.
Details of Japanese and foreigners' investments were as follows (in billions of yen):
Foreign stocks: Net Foreign bonds: Net
Japanese stocks: Net Japanese bonds: Net
Figures are rounded and based on settlements.
